messages:
Maya - Support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting p99 spike ~09:12 UTC, reported latency 5-12s for text generation. Sample ticket IDs: #3244, #3247. They all hit hosted API in us-west. Any ongoing deploy?

Jon - Eng Oncall: seeing elevated queue_length on ingress-proxy: worker_pool backlog ~3000 queued, inflight stable, admission_drop_rate increased from 0.2% to 12%.

Maya - Support: Some see 429s and some long tails. Customer says retries pile up.

Alex - SRE: graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/ingress?from=now-1h TO now — looks like a sudden spike at 09:11:45, correlated with batcher saturation and slower model responses on g4dn nodes.

Irene - Runtime: model-serving pod logs show repeated 'AcquireCache lock timeout' and `kvcache.miss` rate up 6x. Might be KV cache contention causing per-request CPU spike.

Jon - Eng Oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce per-tenant concurrency: set admission.control.concurrency_limit=8 for tenant-segment 'burst' 2) enable prefix_kv_cache_bypass for small models 3) scale dedicated-worker pool +2 replicas

Samir - Platform: Pushing a hot config now. Patch:
```yaml
admission:
  global_concurrency_limit: 2000
  per_tenant_overrides:
    burst: 8
  fail_fast_threshold_ms: 5000
```

Samir - Platform: `kubectl patch deploy ingress-admit --namespace=redwood -p '{"spec":{"replicas":10}}'`

Alex - SRE: also temporarily enable `fastfail_on_queue_depth` = true so requests crossing 1s queue return 503 instead of piling up.

Maya - Support: Let customer know we're doing a config change and will follow up with postmortem. interim message: "We've applied a mitigation to reduce incoming concurrency and scale worker fleet — expect improved tail latency in 3-5m :pray:"

OpsBot: Deploy job started by Samir; build id: deploy-2026-03-15-09:17

Samir - Platform: deploy finished, scaled to 10 replicas. Observability shows queue_length dropping.

Alex - SRE: p95 down from 1.8s->0.6s, p99 down from 8s->1.9s after config. Need deeper followup: root cause KV cache lock & model pods with bad GC causing CPU stalls.

Irene - Runtime: collecting heap/profiler from model pods and kvcache stats. Will open follow-up ticket + patch to reduce cache lock hold time.

Jon - Eng Oncall: leave this thread open for customer confirmation, will create incident postmortem ticket INC-2026-032.

Maya - Support: Customer confirmed improved latency. Closing from support side after postmortem.
